description: This Java class defines an index extension for Android resource IDs within the IntelliJ IDEA platform, parsing XML files to index resource IDs and references.

classes.name: AndroidIdIndex
classes.description: A file index extension for indexing Android resource IDs and references in XML files.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the index ID for Android ID index.

methods.name: getIndexer
methods.description: Provides the data indexer that processes file content to extract resource IDs.

methods.name: getKeyDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the key descriptor for index keys.

methods.name: getValueExternalizer
methods.description: Provides the externalizer for index values.

methods.name: getInputFilter
methods.description: Filters input files to only process local XML files.

methods.name: dependsOnFileContent
methods.description: Indicates that the index depends on file content.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the index.
